originalUserMessages:
Run ONE actual saved Kiro Workflow against frozen game HEAD 02b1bf8785f154dcee8e2a21293d6a455a3bf82e. You are in isolated branch kiro/final-polish-verification. No model override. Other agents own integration and web/menu review.

Read AGENTS.md and .kiro/workflows/orb-duel-replay.workflow.json only as needed. Use Kiro's actual native run_workflow tool with workflowPath to run the saved orb-duel-replay recipe ONCE; label orb-duel-replay-final-polish. Do not reimplement the steps and call it a Workflow. Its three steps run node scripts/verify-duel.mjs --browser (157 expected Node tests, source asset structure preflight, standalone build, seed0 Chrome replay), then node scripts/browser-match-check.mjs --showcase --summary --out-dir .artifacts/kiro/showcase (seed60, same HTML), then its report.

No app, test, source, recipe, build script, model or asset edits. No web build; coordinator owns separate web/menu checks. No config, grant, backend or model changes. Do not read account usage/credentials. NEVER delete .artifacts or launch logs, git clean, or broad rm. Raw output stays ignored. Do not commit, push, deploy, or create any public artifacts: coordinator will collect and sanitize actual receipts.

Use the native Workflow output as evidence. At the end report actual workflow ID, final status, exact session-store workflow-state path, step exits, Node count, seeds/steps/errors and HTML SHA256 if returned, report path. Never fabricate IDs or success. If workflow unavailable or a step fails, preserve output and stop without fallback reruns/source fixes. A missing field is pending. Do not repeatedly poll; use a normal blocking native run or a single wait if necessary. Finish within 4 minutes; launch watchdog is 5 minutes.
